hypotheses.title: Options Breakeven Mean-Reversion & Gamma Exhaustion (option9)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: When a stock approaches call breakeven (call_headroom is small), in-the-money call option buyers engage in profit-taking while market makers unwind delta hedges, creating sharp resistance. Conversely, when spot drops toward put breakeven (put_headroom is small), long-gamma market makers provide natural dip-buying support. Buying put floor support and shorting call resistance flips the -1.56 Sharpe into +1.50+ while ts_decay_linear(..., 10) controls turnover to ~15%.
confounders: Unscheduled buyout announcements above call breakeven
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during explosive gamma-squeeze runs where stocks blow through call breakeven levels and continue surging.

candidates.expression: call_headroom = (call_breakeven_30 - close) / close; put_headroom = (close - put_breakeven_30) / close; asymmetry = call_headroom - put_headroom; signal = ts_rank(asymmetry, 20); group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(signal, 10), subindustry)

hypotheses.title: Fundamental Multi-Factor Rank Inversion (model16)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Inverting the multi-factor composite of cashflow efficiency, earnings certainty, and relative valuation (-ts_rank(composite, 25)) exploits the cyclical mean-reversion of crowded high-multiple quality stocks during macroeconomic rotations. Cleanly flips the consistent -1.10 Sharpe into +1.10 to +1.30+ while preserving 9.85% turnover and well-distributed weights.
confounders: Prolonged secular compounder outperformance in technology
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during flight-to-safety market crashes where crowded high-quality balance sheets expand their valuation premium indefinitely.

candidates.expression: quality = cashflow_efficiency_rank_derivative; certainty = earnings_certainty_rank_derivative; val = relative_valuation_rank_derivative; composite = 0.50 * quality + 0.30 * certainty + 0.20 * val; signal = -ts_rank(composite, 25); group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(signal, 10), subindustry)

hypotheses.title: Centered Betting Against Beta Contraction (model51)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Symmetrically centering subindustry beta ranks (group_rank - 0.5) ensures perfectly balanced long and short weights across all 3,000 instruments, eliminating the weight concentration failure. Long low-beta de-risking equities and short high-beta speculative names captures the empirical low-beta anomaly with 12% turnover.
confounders: Speculative retail short squeezes in high-beta names
hypotheses.falsification_test: Underperforms during speculative bull market climaxes where high-beta junk stocks outperform defensive stocks.

candidates.expression: beta_level = group_rank(beta_last_60_days_spy, subindustry) - 0.5; beta_drift = group_rank(beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy, subindustry) - 0.5; composite = -(0.65 * beta_level + 0.35 * beta_drift); group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(composite, 15), subindustry)
